   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Sep 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mattallsop_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
            2. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
            3. __Abs_95_, Sep 19, 2026, 2/5: "Posting here because the glitchy app wouldn’t let me submit my review. This trial period feels so scammy and cheap and I’d love to see your retention figures from it. Only being able to visit each studio once is such a shortsighted membership ruling. Why would I want to spend £49 a month to see if I enjoy doing something for more than 50 minutes. The app is badly designed and lacking information. Honestly if I had spent any money for this I would be asking for it back as I see little to no user value for your service. I’d rather pay £10 extra a month and just pay studios directly so I’m not on a waitlist for classes or having to navigate your system. It’s like you’ve created insurance for exercise classes, but without the handbooks."
